description: An expander for TL_Seq4 that sends reset pulses to it, placed immediately to the left or the right of the sequencer; each of its two halves picks which side it sends to.

params.text: Sends a reset pulse out of the A half each time it is pressed.
Chooses whether the A half sends its reset to the module on the left or the module on the right.
Sends a reset pulse out of the B half each time it is pressed.
Chooses whether the B half sends its reset to the module on the left or the module on the right.

inputs.text: A voltage over 1V in either direction counts as high, and going high sends a reset pulse out of the A half.
A voltage over 1V in either direction counts as high, and going high sends a reset pulse out of the B half.

notes: A pulse only reaches a neighbour that is a TL_Seq4. Any other module beside it, or an empty space, receives nothing and the press does nothing.
Each half sends on the rising edge only: a held button or a held gate sends one pulse, not a stream.

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
